name: ukb
description: UK Biobank participant identifiers (eids) and approved-platform data rules

id.label: eid
id.pattern_source: Adopted verbatim from UK-Biobank/UKB-Git-Audit-Tool src/utilities.py regex_pattern(). Keep in sync: UKB's tool is the authoritative compliance check, and this scanner must never report clean where theirs reports a hit.
pattern_notes: Range is 1000000-6500000: real eids do not exceed ~6.5M, so a wider ceiling only adds false positives.
(?<!rs)(?<!RS)(?<!Rs)(?<!rS) excludes SNP rsIDs, which are pervasive in genetics code.
(?<!\.) excludes the fractional part of a float such as 0.1234567.
Deliberately no \b anchors: \b fails between a letter and a digit (patient5082392) and before an underscore (3081375_20215_0_0.zip), both of which are real UKB identifier forms.

sensitive_filenames.note: UKB withdrawal list — contains participant IDs of withdrawn consent; must never be shared or referenced by absolute path in shared code
UKB application-keyed file (w<app>_<date>) — application-linked participant data

path_patterns.hint: UKB application number — identifies the access agreement; move to config
